manifest.reasoningEffort: not set by the run; agent default
manifest.method: Claude Code Agent tool, general-purpose subagent, one fresh agent per job launched in parallel. Each agent was told to read its job file (copied to /tmp) and answer it as its only task, with no other reads and no skills. Agents inherit the Claude Code system prompt, so the job text was not the only context.
